questions.question: Have you designed or changed the schema of a PostgreSQL database that an application writes to, rather than reading from it for analytics?
questions.why: His CV shows PostgreSQL only as a source for pipelines; this must-have is unverified.
follow_ups: What indexes did you add, and why?

questions.question: Tell me about any change you've made to a production database's structure, in any setting. How did you make sure nothing broke?
questions.why: Must-have with no evidence on his CV; give him room to show experience he didn't list.
follow_ups: What would you do differently on a table that's being written to constantly?
warning_signs: no experience, and no sense of the risks

questions.question: You built pipelines that load from PostgreSQL read replicas. What problems did reading from replicas cause, and how did you handle them?
evidence: Built Airflow pipelines loading data from PostgreSQL read replicas into Snowflake
questions.why: The closest evidence to the must-have; tests how deep his PostgreSQL knowledge goes.
follow_ups: How did replication lag affect your data?

notes_for_interviewer: Both must-haves are unverified on his CV: the gap probes decide whether to continue. Data warehouse experience doesn't count toward them (see the brief's anti-goals).
